name: Maldives
intro: Escape to private overwater bungalows, turquoise lagoons, and white-sand bioluminescent beaches. The Maldives is the ultimate remote luxury sanctuary.
weather: Warm and tropical year-round. Average daytime temperature is 30°C. Brief monsoon rains occur from May to October.
visaInfo: Free 30-day visa on arrival issued to all nationalities.
flightDuration: Approx 4-5 hours from major Indian airports.
highlights: Stay in a luxury overwater villa with private lagoon slide
Snorkel or dive with whale sharks and giant manta rays
Enjoy private sandbank picnics isolated in the Indian Ocean
Dine in underwater glass restaurants surrounded by coral reefs

famousPlaces.name: Malé & Private Atolls
famousPlaces.shortDesc: Private luxury islands offering white beaches, coral reefs, and isolated overwater bungalows.
famousPlaces.overview: The Maldives is composed of 1,200 coral islands grouped in atolls. Our selected private island resort offers absolute isolation, where the house reef is just steps from your villa deck.

hotels.name: Soneva Jani Resort
hotels.description: Ultra-luxury overwater villas with retractable roofs and private water slides.

famousPlaces.meals: All-inclusive gourmet menus at resort restaurants.
famousPlaces.transport: Roundtrip luxury speedboat or private seaplane transfers.
famousPlaces.activities: Manta Ray Snorkeling, Private Sunset Cruise, Sandbank Dinner.
included: Overwater villa stay with lagoon slide

faqs.q: How do we reach the private resort?
faqs.a: After landing at Malé International Airport, our airport representative will guide you to the seaplane terminal for transfer.

reviews.author: Anjali R.
reviews.text: The seaplane transfer was spectacular. Soneva Jani is absolute paradise.

itinerary.title: Seaplane Flight & Lagoon Check-in
itinerary.morning: Fly by seaplane over pristine coral rings. Check into Soneva Jani.
itinerary.afternoon: Slide directly from your villa deck into the turquoise lagoon.
itinerary.evening: Sunset champagne cruise searching for local spinner dolphins.

itinerary.title: Snorkeling with Mantas & Sandbank Dinner
itinerary.morning: Board a luxury Dhoni boat to snorkel with manta rays at the bay.
itinerary.afternoon: Relax with a signature spa treatment inside the overwater sanctuary.
itinerary.evening: Private lantern-lit barbecue dinner on a deserted sandbank.
